newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian gets jail term after leaving panty trail.
newsitem.headline: Canadian gets jail term after leaving panty trail.

text.p: A man who stole women's underwear and then got caught after leaving a trail of lingerie was sentenced to six and a half months in jail, his lawyer said on Tuesday.
Steven Qualtier was arrested by police earlier this month after he was seen tossing bras, panties and other items from his car window while he was driving, lawyer Ian McAndrew said.

Neighbours said they saw Qualtier earlier stuffing the lingerie along with other clothing in his shirt at a home he had broken into. He was sentenced on Monday for the break-in as well as for another home robbery where he took lingerie.
Qualtier told the court it was all a joke, but the judge said the conviction was a serious one. The judge also suggested the defendant get psychological help.
"I don't think he knew what he was doing," said McAndrew. "I think he has a serious problem with alcohol."
